title: General Framework to Evaluate Unlinkability in Biometric Template Protection Systems
reasoning: The paper extensively discusses 'privacy concerns' regarding the storage and use of biometric data, 'privacy preservation', and the implications of the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) for biometric data.
